title: EU customer PII is stored and processed in a US-region workspace
detail: All workspace compute and storage bill to US_EAST_OHIO SKUs; eurostream.bronze.orders holds clear email/iban. ADR 0001 requires EU-only storage and processing, and no transfer outside the EU.
impact: A GDPR Chapter V transfer issue today, unless a transfer basis exists; the whole existing deployment would need to move.

evidence.excerpt: PREMIUM_DATABRICKS_STORAGE_US_EAST_OHIO 7.40 DBU
All storage and processing is pinned to EU regions

target: New workspace + metastore in an EU region (e.g. eu-central-1); see FND-SEC-VX-RES-1

title: Erased customers reappear in Silver/Gold on the next full rebuild
detail: build_silver deletes and re-inserts silver.customers from bronze.orders grouped by customer_id with no suppression_registry filter. Erasure only masks Bronze, so the customer_id comes back.
impact: An erasure is undone by the next full transform; a faithful migration carries it into Lakeflow.

evidence.excerpt: DELETE FROM silver.customers; INSERT … FROM bronze.orders GROUP BY customer_id

target: Silver anti-join on suppression registry in the Lakeflow pipeline; the existing workspace build already excludes the suppressed customer (0 rows in silver/gold)

title: Erasure never reaches the event bus; topics carry clear PII
detail: Order events carry email and iban in clear text; payments carry iban, clicks ip_address. Erasure updates warehouse tables only; nothing deletes or compacts Kafka topics or the SQLite messages log.
impact: Replaying a topic restores erased PII into Bronze; on Databricks a Kafka source with startingOffsets=earliest would do the same.

evidence.excerpt: model_dump_json() with email, iban
_anonymize_warehouse — warehouse statements only

target: Tokenize PII before it reaches the bus, or set topic retention below the erasure SLA; Bronze ingest filters suppressed ids

title: Pseudonymized customer data is published to a public Hugging Face dataset
detail: orchestrate.yml creates the dataset without private=True and uploads data/lake (customer_id, email_hash, iban_hash) every 4 h. Erasure never reaches it. The provider region is unknown.
impact: Pseudonymous data is still personal data under GDPR; a public copy outside the EU cannot be recalled.

evidence.excerpt: upload_folder(folder_path='data/lake' …)

conflicts.note: 'No code path transfers data outside the EU'

target: Retire the public upload; if sharing is required, Delta Sharing of an aggregated, anonymized share

title: API has no authentication; erase and customer endpoints are public
detail: No auth dependency on any route, including POST /erase/{customer_id}, POST /transform and GET /gold/customer-360. CORS allows any origin with credentials. The service is deployed on Render with autoDeploy.
impact: Anyone can trigger erasures or read the customer table.

evidence.excerpt: allow_origins=["*"]
@app.post("/erase/{customer_id}") — no Depends

target: Databricks App with workspace OAuth + on-behalf-of-user SQL; erasure as a job triggered with a service principal

title: SQL injection in GET /verify-erasure/{customer_id}
detail: Five queries interpolate the raw path parameter with f-strings; the S608 lint is suppressed with noqa. /gold/customer-360 search is only quote-doubled.
impact: Arbitrary SQL against the warehouse from an unauthenticated endpoint.

evidence.excerpt: f"… WHERE customer_id = '{customer_id}'"  # noqa: S608

target: Parameterised queries (named parameters in the SQL connector)

title: PII salt has a public hard-coded default and is inlined into SQL
detail: PII_SALT = "eurostream-pii-salt" in config.py; docker-compose does not override it; build_silver interpolates it into SQL text.
impact: Anyone with the repo can reverse low-entropy hashed emails and IBANs, so the hashes give no pseudonymization.

evidence.excerpt: PII_SALT = "eurostream-pii-salt"
sha256('{salt}:' || arg_max(email, occurred_at))

title: Malformed events dropped silently

title: DuckDB-specific SQL throughout the warehouse layer
detail: INSERT OR IGNORE / INSERT OR REPLACE (≥ 11 sites), arg_max, bool_and, COPY … TO PARQUET and read_parquet('hf://…') rely on DuckDB semantics and PK enforcement Delta lacks.
impact: Not a transpile; each becomes MERGE or a declarative pipeline (conversion driver).

title: Shared single connections across threads and processes
detail: SqliteBus shares one connection (check_same_thread=False) guarded by a process-local lock while produce and stream run as separate processes. The API shares one DuckDB Warehouse across requests and opens stores at import time.
impact: Lock errors and inconsistent reads under load; import-time side effects in tests.

evidence.excerpt: check_same_thread=False

target: SQL warehouse / Lakebase connection pooling

title: Workspace has no PII tags, masks, row filters or grants on the eurostream catalog
